knownDeltas: Export pixels are engine-native VIPS output over the published raster: there is no Esri reference render to diff against, so the gate is structural (PNG signature, IHDR dimensions, raster headers, non-trivial body) plus an RMSE determinism check between two identical exports (RMSE must be 0: the same render is pixel-identical to itself), never byte equality and never a perceptual hash against a foreign image.
name: imageserver-export-image
notes: Export image (ImageServer/exportImage?f=image): the doc-pattern bbox/size/format over the published raster; the replay gates the PNG structurally plus RMSE determinism because renderers are never byte-equal across engines.
source: Esri REST docs: Export Image (https://developers.arcgis.com/rest/services-reference/enterprise/export-image.htm); f=image pattern
